name: Hallucinatory Terrain
summary: Make natural terrain in a 150-foot Cube look, sound and smell like a different kind of terrain for 24 hours.
text: Natural terrain in a 150-foot Cube within range looks, sounds and smells like some other kind of natural terrain for the duration: a meadow might pass for a bog, a pond for dry grass, or a sheer drop for an easy slope. Buildings, equipment and creatures in the area keep their appearance. The illusion fools only those senses, not touch, so a creature that enters the area usually notices it at once. If the difference isn't obvious by touch, a creature can take the Study action to examine the illusion and make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to disbelieve it; a creature that sees through it sees a faint image laid over the real terrain. Lasts 24 hours. Casting time 10 minutes.
